name: MCP Connector Bridge
description: Workflow for discovering, validating, documenting, and safely using Model Context Protocol servers as Lilly connector surfaces.

chain.step: Identify the requested external system, data source, or tool server and whether an MCP server already exists.
Fetch official server docs, auth requirements, supported tools/resources/prompts, and install instructions.
Classify side effects, credential requirements, data exposure, and approval gates before runtime wiring.
Use remote-cli-agent only for scoped installation, config, smoke testing, or deployment work after inventory and approval.
Return a connector card with server name, auth, tools, resources, prompts, risks, setup commands, smoke test, and rollback.
